'''Maraq''' ({{langx|ar|مرق}}) is a [[broth]] or [[soup]] dish commonly eaten in the [[Greater Somalia]] region and the [[Arabian Peninsula]][[Saudi Arabia|.]] It can also be found in [[Indonesia]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-10-13 |title=Maraq fahfah {{!}} Somali lamb broth - Recipes - Healthier Families |url=https://www.nhs.uk/healthier-families/recipes/maraq-fahfah-somali-soup/ |access-date=2024-02-04 |website=nhs.uk |language=en}}</ref>
